description: Minimal valid pacs.008 message containing only required elements. Demonstrates the absolute minimum fields needed for a valid customer credit transfer.
test_coverage: Group header with mandatory fields (MsgId, CreDtTm, NbOfTxs)
Single transaction with required payment identification (InstrId, EndToEndId)
Debtor and creditor with names only
Debtor and creditor accounts with IBANs
Debtor and creditor agents with BIC codes
business_rules_expected_to_pass: PACS008-DT01: Settlement date not in past
PACS008-IB01: Valid debtor IBAN with Mod-97
PACS008-IB02: Valid creditor IBAN with Mod-97
notes: This is the simplest valid pacs.008 message. It uses EUR currency, German and French banks, valid IBANs, and shared charge bearer. No optional fields are populated.
